titre: Choisir l'angle ou la séquence adaptés à chaque prospect
description: Avant d'écrire, on décide. Jev lit ce qu'on sait du prospect (poste, entreprise, secteur, effectif, signal, notes) et choisit l'angle d'approche parmi les vôtres ; la rédaction du message, sur les seules lignes retenues, revient ensuite à un LLM ou à un humain. Environ 200 tokens par lead avec le brief : 8 $ le million de leads. Les angles ci-dessous sont un exemple (un cabinet de prospection externalisée pour PME B2B) : remplacez-les par les vôtres, un angle par situation observable.

instructions.offer: We sell outsourced outbound prospecting (booked meetings) to French B2B SMEs. Each angle below is a sequence we already wrote; the choice depends on the most recent observable fact about the prospect, not on their sector.
instructions.question: Given `offer`, which angle fits this prospect best, judging from `signal` and `notes` first, then `poste`, `entreprise`, `secteur` and `effectif`? When two angles apply, take the one tied to the most recent dated fact. Choose 'standard' when nothing specific is known.

criteria.recrutement_commercial: The company is hiring or just hired a sales person (SDR, business developer, commercial, head of sales): the angle is meetings from day one while the hire ramps up.
criteria.levee_de_fonds: The company announced a fundraise, a grant or a new investor in the last six months: the angle is turning the new budget into pipeline fast.
criteria.dirigeant_seul_a_vendre: The founder or CEO does the selling personally and there is no sales team: the angle is giving the founder their time back.
criteria.nouveau_marche: The company opens a new territory, country, segment or product line: the angle is prospecting the new market without staffing it.
criteria.outillage_absent: The notes say there is no CRM, no sequencing tool or no prospecting process: the angle is a turnkey machine, tooling included.
criteria.standard: No specific fact is known, or the facts are older than six months: the generic sequence.
